title: Periscope Depth
author: Declan Bigger
problems: Row 3 "neighbors allemande right ¼ to long wavy lines - larks face in, robins out" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 3 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
Row 4 "balance & box circulate - larks cross while robins loop right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 1 is not standing in a side line.
Row 4 "balance & box circulate - larks cross while robins loop right · box circulate" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers who cross must face in across the set.
Row 5 "balance & box circulate - robins cross while larks loop right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 1 is not standing in a side line.
Row 5 "balance & box circulate - robins cross while larks loop right · box circulate" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers who cross must face in across the set.
Row 3 "neighbors allemande right ¼ to long wavy lines - larks face in, robins out" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 7 are too far apart to turn by the hand.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
